title: Trustworthy Intelligent Education: A Systematic Perspective on Progress, Challenges, and Future Directions

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing debiasing methods that utilize counterfactual reasoning frameworks to identify and subtract answer bias as a direct causal effect in knowledge tracing models.
Reviewing approaches that apply causal learning and knowledge disentanglement to explore and mitigate counterfactual effects causing cognitive biases in educational modeling.

Reviewing fairness-aware training and path-specific causal inference frameworks that use attribute-decoupling, orthogonal learning, and min-max fairness objectives to eliminate disparities and unfair treatment across different student groups.
